name: Arch 22
subtitle: Arch 22 is a monument at the entrance to Banjul, made a national monument in 2000.

facts.label: Size
facts.value: Three floors, 42 m high and 30 m wide

facts.label: Exhibitions
facts.value: Shows pictures both celebrating Jammeh's rule and depicting its human rights violations

parts.text: Arch 22 is a monument at the entrance to Banjul, made a national monument in 2000. It was built in 1995-1996 and today shows exhibitions in its upper floors.
